name: Symmetry

frame.name: Revolution
frame.description:
This weapon fires full auto.
[Alternate Weapon Action]  : Swap to Arc Seeker mode. Arc Seekers track toward combatants you target.

perks.name: Dynamic Charge
perks.description: Final blows and precision hits build up Dynamic Charge. Swapping to Arc Seeker mode increases damage and partially reloads the magazine based on the number of charges. Charged Arc Seeker hits grant, and can spend, Bolt Charge.

perks.name: Composite Stock
perks.description:
This weapon has a versatile dual-purpose stock.
  •  Slightly increases stability
  •  Slightly increases handling speed

flavor: "Duality is not a curse, but a gift." —Author unknown

catalyst.name: Symmetry Catalyst
catalyst.description:
Temporarily increases reload speed and handling after sprinting or while amplified. This effect is improved when you are amplified.
Increases the maximum number of Dynamic Charge stacks.
